name: @astra/orator-controller
description: Elgato Stream Deck plugin that remote-controls orator-backend (collection→tag navigation, live now-playing) over its HTTP REST API. Node runtime (Elgato SDK); in the pnpm workspace for typecheck/test only — tsdown builds the .streamDeckPlugin.

scripts.package: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir .tsbuild && tsdown && streamdeck pack com.astra.orator.sdPlugin --output dist --force --no-update-check --ignore-validation
